content.thinking: The question: "What did George Brown (1818-1880) refuse in 1875?" Answer: he refused the position of lieutenant-governor of Ontario in 1875. Multiple sources confirm. Give brief answer and URL.

content.text:
George Brown (1818–1880) 在 1875 年拒绝的是**安大略省省督（lieutenant-governor of Ontario）一职**。

依据：加拿大百科全书（The Canadian Encyclopedia）等来源记载：“Brown refused the position of lieutenant-governor of Ontario in 1875”。

- https://thecanadianencyclopedia.ca/en/article/george-brown
- https://parks.canada.ca/culture/designation/personnage-person/... （George Brown House National Historic Site）

（注：他在 1879 年还拒绝了爵士头衔，但那不是 1875 年。）
